anchor.snippet: bool re_hex_set(ReHexView *v, const char *hex, long long base, long long size) {

entries.note: The view holds one 64 KiB window decoded from the service's hex string; base and size are 64-bit so offsets into multi-hundred-megabyte archives are exact while the window itself stays small enough to embed in the struct. Rows are formatted on demand (offset, 8+8 byte groups, printable ASCII with dots) and the first row is exposed for inspection so fixtures assert bytes, not pixels.
